concerns.text: FR‑008 requires a check that core constructs (discount_rate_k, procrastination_score, wm_* columns) are present before any analysis proceeds. No task implements this halt‑on‑missing‑constructs check, violating the specification.

SC‑004 mandates a verification step that flags when the bootstrap confidence interval for the interaction effect crosses zero in > 50 % of the sensitivity‑sweep thresholds. No task creates or records such a flag, so the acceptance criterion is dropped.
SC‑005 requires enforcement of a ≤ 6 hour runtime and ≤ 7 GB memory usage. The task list contains no monitoring or fail‑loud step that validates these limits, leaving the specification unmet.

The plan states that the study uses a synthetic Data‑Generating Process as the *primary* analysis strategy. FR‑001 explicitly requires ingestion of real, validated datasets; using synthetic data as the main analysis constitutes an unauthorized scope expansion and weakens the functional requirement.

concerns.text: Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) demands a step that validates citations for the DGP parameters. No task invokes a Reference‑Validator or similar verification, violating the constitutional non‑negotiable.

The task list references T032 (resource usage) in the dependency map, but no concrete task implements resource‑usage monitoring or updates the state YAML with CPU/memory metrics, breaking the link to FR‑010 and SC‑005.

The dependency map lists FR‑009 (≤10 % ID drop) but there is no explicit verification task that aborts the pipeline if the drop exceeds 10 % after harmonization, nor a report that records this condition.
